type Bad = { n: int }

check(x: int) -> int fail Bad =
  ex check(4) == 4
  if x % 2 == 1
    fail Bad(n: x)
  x

-- Checks every element in parallel. On failure, returns the Bad of the
-- lowest-index odd element, regardless of which thread finishes first.
all_even(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] fail Bad =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex all_even([2, 4]) == [2, 4]
  let ys = par for x in xs
    check(x)?
  ys
